supplements.title: Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose to Alleviate Depressive and Anxiety Symptoms in Patients With Cancer: A Network Meta-Analysis and Dose-Response Study.
supplements.summary: Exercise reduces depression and anxiety in cancer patients, with optimal benefits from moderate-intensity aerobic activity at 150 minutes weekly.

supplements.title: Resveratrol coordinates apoptosis and autophagy in hepatocellular carcinoma cells via p53 acetylation: An integrative network pharmacology and experimental validation study.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol kills liver cancer cells by activating a protein called p53, which simultaneously triggers two death mechanisms: apoptosis and autophagy.

supplements.title: A ginsenoside metabolite and its derivative target PRELID3B against lung cancer cells.
supplements.summary: A ginseng-derived compound called CKD-4 inhibits lung cancer growth by targeting a mitochondrial protein called PRELID3B.

supplements.title: Novel nitric oxide-releasing triptolidenol derivatives suppress gastric cancer by targeting the folate one-carbon metabolism pathway and inducing ROS accumulation.
supplements.summary: A new nitric oxide-releasing compound A9 effectively kills gastric cancer cells by generating damaging molecules and disrupting cancer cell metabolism.

supplements.title: Rational design, synthesis and effective mechanism of sophoridine and matrine contains 2,3,4-triphenylpyridine derivatives as TopoⅠ inhibitors for the treatment of gastric carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers designed new compounds (H4 and K8) that inhibit topoisomerase I to effectively kill gastric cancer cells and stop tumor growth.

supplements.title: Kojic acid inhibits melanoma progression by targeting the MYC-CCNA2/KPNA2 axis.
supplements.summary: Kojic acid stops melanoma growth by blocking a protein that drives cancer cell proliferation and survival.

supplements.title: Integrated Computational Omics Approach to Identify Novel Natural Product Inhibitors Targeting KIF11 in Endometrial Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified glycocholic acid, a natural compound, as a promising drug candidate to target KIF11 protein overexpressed in endometrial cancer.

supplements.title: Biodegradable PCL-PLGA Electrospun Nanofibers for Localized Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Engineered nanofibers deliver cancer drugs directly to tumors with sustained release and reduced side effects compared to conventional chemotherapy.

supplements.title: Beyond Amyloids: Neuroprotective Potential of Betanin and its Derivatives Against Alpha-Synuclein Aggregates and ROS Overload in Parkinson's Disease.
supplements.summary: Beetroot-derived betaxanthin compounds reduce toxic protein clumps and oxidative stress in Parkinson's disease models, showing neuroprotective potential.

supplements.title: Exploring the Role of Probiotics in the Prevention and Treatment of Gastrointestinal Cancer.
supplements.summary: Probiotics may help prevent and treat gastrointestinal cancer by reducing inflammation, strengthening gut barriers, and boosting immune responses.

supplements.title: Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial of Meriva® (curcuminoids) as a Candidate Chemoprevention Agent for Gastric Carcinogenesis.
supplements.summary: Curcumin supplement reduced stomach inflammation in high-risk gastric cancer patients, showing promise as a preventive treatment.

supplements.title: Vitamin C Conditioning Generates Tumor-Targeting CAR T Cells with Superior Cytotoxicity and Fitness in a Posttransplant Lymphoproliferative Disorder Tumor Model.
supplements.summary: Vitamin C conditioning improves CAR T-cell effectiveness against posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder by enhancing cytotoxicity and cell persistence.

supplements.title: Exceptional and typical biomarker responses to AminoTriComplex in metastatic prostate cancer: a case series.
supplements.summary: A supplement called AminoTriComplex showed promise in treating metastatic prostate cancer by targeting inflammation and hormone signaling.

supplements.title: Bio-functional and anti-cancer (MCF-7) benzyl isothiocyanate nanoemulsions preparation using green pressurized water and process optimization.
supplements.summary: Researchers created nanoemulsion particles of benzyl isothiocyanate that effectively killed breast cancer cells while improving stability and water solubility.

supplements.title: How the Ketogenic Diet Shapes the Microbiome to Influence Cancer Immunotherapy Outcomes: An Exploration of Clinical Trials and Their Results.
supplements.summary: Ketogenic diets may improve cancer immunotherapy outcomes by reshaping gut bacteria, though clinical evidence combining both approaches remains lacking.

off_label.title: Repurposing Drugs for Malaria through a Human Dose Prediction: A Case Study with Berzosertib.
off_label.summary: Researchers predict that an anticancer drug called berzosertib could treat malaria at safe doses lower than those used for cancer therapy.

off_label.title: Loss of JAK1 Function Causes G2-M Cell-Cycle Defects Vulnerable to KIF18A Inhibition.
off_label.summary: Blocking JAK1 in head and neck cancer makes tumors resistant to radiation, but adding a KIF18A inhibitor overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Delivery of nano-formulated drugs to solid tumours is selectively increased by co-application of the vascular disrupting agent CA4P.
off_label.summary: Combining a vascular-disrupting agent with nano-formulated drugs significantly improves drug delivery to solid tumors.

off_label.title: Rosuvastatin enhances the efficacy of venetoclax-azacitidine in older acute myeloid leukemia patients via reducing T-cell exhaustion.
off_label.summary: Adding rosuvastatin to venetoclax-azacitidine improves treatment response in older AML patients by reducing T-cell exhaustion.

off_label.title: Lipophilic Statins Deplete GPX4 to Promote Ferroptosis and Sensitize Cancer Cells to Immune Checkpoint Blockade.
off_label.summary: Lipophilic statins kill melanoma and colorectal cancer cells by depleting a protective protein, and combining them with immunotherapy cures tumors in most mice.

off_label.title: Mineralocorticoid and glucocorticoid receptor cooperation drives advanced phenotypes in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Two receptor proteins working together drive aggressive triple-negative breast cancer; blocking this interaction reduced tumor spread in mice.

off_label.title: Downregulation of claudin-2 expression and chemoresistance by saquinavir in human lung adenocarcinoma cells.
off_label.summary: Saquinavir, an HIV drug, reduces a protein called claudin-2 in lung adenocarcinoma cells, making them more sensitive to chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Angiotensin II Type 1 Receptor Blockade Inhibits Gastric Cancer Metastasis Through Tight Junction Restoration.
off_label.summary: Blocking angiotensin II signaling restores cell junctions and prevents gastric cancer metastasis in preclinical models.

off_label.title: The Emerging Role of Metformin in Skin Cancer: Mechanistic and Clinical Insights.
off_label.summary: Metformin, a diabetes drug, may help prevent and treat skin cancer by boosting immune response and altering cancer metabolism.

off_label.title: Pembrolizumab as an Off-Label Treatment of Facial Angiosarcoma: A Case Report.
off_label.summary: Pembrolizumab, an immunotherapy drug, successfully controlled facial angiosarcoma in an elderly patient when combined with radiation therapy.

off_label.title: GLS1 Orchestrates Exosome-Mediated Tumor-Endothelial Communication to Facilitate Angiogenesis.
off_label.summary: GLS1 protein promotes blood vessel growth in head and neck cancer by packaging pro-angiogenic molecules into exosomes that signal to blood vessel cells.

off_label.title: Combined purslane ethanolic extract and metformin attenuate cognitive dysfunction in HFD/STZ-induced diabetic rats via modulation of oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and neurotransmitters.
off_label.summary: Purslane extract combined with metformin improved memory problems in diabetic rats by reducing brain inflammation and oxidative stress.

off_label.title: Spatially resolved ex vivo drug response profiling in SMARCB1-deficient sinonasal carcinoma.
off_label.summary: mTOR inhibitor Sapanisertib effectively kills aggressive sinonasal carcinoma cells by targeting stem-like tumor populations in patient tissue samples.

off_label.title: Acarbose modulates microglial Pkm2 acetylation to reshape immunometabolism and preserve retinal neurons after ischemia-reperfusion.
off_label.summary: Acarbose protects retinal neurons from injury by reducing harmful inflammation and restoring energy metabolism through a specific protein modification pathway.

off_label.title: In silico analysis of gene expression signatures and drug repurposing associated with metastatic progression in melanoma (skin cancer).
off_label.summary: Researchers identified five key genes driving melanoma spread and found two existing drugs that could potentially target these genes in metastatic skin cancer.

biomarkers.title: Altered crosstalk of bacterial lipopolysaccharide with immune cells in colorectal cancer compared to paired adjacent intestinal tissue.
biomarkers.summary: Bacterial toxins interact differently with immune cells in colorectal cancer tumors versus healthy nearby tissue, potentially affecting immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Rab5 improves CAR T cell efficacy via reducing fratricide and maintaining surface CAR levels.
biomarkers.summary: Adding Rab5 protein to CAR T cells improves their cancer-fighting ability by reducing self-destruction and maintaining tumor-targeting receptors.

biomarkers.title: TACI regulates marginal zone B cell development.
biomarkers.summary: TACI protein is required for developing marginal zone B cells through a specific cellular pathway involving PI3K-AKT and FOXO1 regulation.

biomarkers.title: FTO promotes bladder cancer progression and stemness-associated phenotypes.
biomarkers.summary: FTO protein promotes bladder cancer growth and stem cell properties; blocking it suppresses tumor progression in mice.

biomarkers.title: Integrative genomic and functional characterization of ADAMTS3 reveals its inflammatory regulation via NF-κB and STAT3 pathways in osteosarcoma.
biomarkers.summary: ADAMTS-3 protein is overexpressed in osteosarcoma and drives tumor growth through inflammatory pathways, offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: ATP2B1 expression identifies human hematopoietic stem cells with superior repopulation and self-renewal.
biomarkers.summary: ATP2B1 protein identifies the most capable human blood-forming stem cells with superior growth and self-renewal abilities.

biomarkers.title: Stag2-mediated chromatin dynamics regulates antibody class switch recombination.
biomarkers.summary: Stag2 protein is essential for antibody diversity by regulating how B cells rearrange their DNA during immune response and cancer development.

biomarkers.title: VEGF-D-induced intraosseous lymphangiogenesis drives site-specific heterotopic bone resorption.
biomarkers.summary: VEGF-D protein promotes lymphatic vessel growth that triggers bone resorption, offering a potential treatment for abnormal bone formation after injury.

biomarkers.title: Renal Cell Carcinoma With Concurrent Loss of SMARCB1/INI-1 and Fumarate Hydratase By Immunohistochemistry: A Case Report With Review of the Literature.
biomarkers.summary: A rare kidney cancer case showed loss of two key proteins; one had a mutation while the other's loss appeared epigenetically caused.

biomarkers.title: Revisiting RAS family GTPase signaling: effector selectivity and oncogenic bypass.
biomarkers.summary: Oncogenic RAS mutations override normal protein selectivity rules, enabling RAS to activate multiple downstream pathways simultaneously in cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Anlotinib plus envafolimab as neoadjuvant therapy in a patient with chemotherapy-refractory advanced endometrial cancer: A case report.
biomarkers.summary: Combination therapy with anlotinib and envafolimab shrank advanced endometrial cancer, enabling surgery and disease-free outcome in chemotherapy-intolerant patient.

biomarkers.title: CXCL11 secreted by cancer-associated fibroblasts promotes nasopharyngeal carcinoma progression via CXCR3/PD-L1 axis.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer-supporting cells secrete CXCL11, which promotes nasopharyngeal carcinoma growth and immune evasion through a specific signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Evolution of Diagnostic Yield for Peripheral Lung Nodule Biopsies With Changes in Navigational Bronchoscopy Platforms, Tools, and Intraoperative Imaging Guidance.
biomarkers.summary: Newer bronchoscopy tools and platforms improved the ability to successfully diagnose lung nodules during minimally invasive procedures.

biomarkers.title: Resveratrol coordinates apoptosis and autophagy in hepatocellular carcinoma cells via p53 acetylation: An integrative network pharmacology and experimental validation study.
biomarkers.summary: Resveratrol kills liver cancer cells by activating a protein called p53, which simultaneously triggers two death mechanisms: apoptosis and autophagy.

biomarkers.title: Precision Medicine in a Patient With Multiple Myeloma Presenting With t(2;11) and CCND1 Overexpression.
biomarkers.summary: A rare multiple myeloma genetic mutation was successfully treated with venetoclax, achieving sustained remission for over three years.

trials.title: Rab5 improves CAR T cell efficacy via reducing fratricide and maintaining surface CAR levels.
trials.summary: Adding Rab5 protein to CAR T cells improves their cancer-fighting ability by reducing self-destruction and maintaining tumor-targeting receptors.

trials.title: Pde4 mediates MHCII expression in oligodendroglia.
trials.summary: Blocking PDE4 signaling reduces immune activation in brain cells and alleviates stress-related depression symptoms in mice.

trials.title: Development and content validation of spiritual care e-book for Chinese breast cancer women undergoing chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Researchers created and tested a digital e-book to help nurses provide spiritual care to Chinese women with breast cancer during chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Anything that helps: cancer patient and carer perspectives on psychedelic-assisted therapy.
trials.summary: Cancer patients and caregivers view psychedelic-assisted therapy as potentially helpful for managing existential distress, despite concerns about stigma and misinformation.

trials.title: Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose to Alleviate Depressive and Anxiety Symptoms in Patients With Cancer: A Network Meta-Analysis and Dose-Response Study.
trials.summary: Exercise reduces depression and anxiety in cancer patients, with optimal benefits from moderate-intensity aerobic activity at 150 minutes weekly.

trials.title: Anlotinib plus envafolimab as neoadjuvant therapy in a patient with chemotherapy-refractory advanced endometrial cancer: A case report.
trials.summary: Combination therapy with anlotinib and envafolimab shrank advanced endometrial cancer, enabling surgery and disease-free outcome in chemotherapy-intolerant patient.

trials.title: Evolution of Diagnostic Yield for Peripheral Lung Nodule Biopsies With Changes in Navigational Bronchoscopy Platforms, Tools, and Intraoperative Imaging Guidance.
trials.summary: Newer bronchoscopy tools and platforms improved the ability to successfully diagnose lung nodules during minimally invasive procedures.

trials.title: Precision Medicine in a Patient With Multiple Myeloma Presenting With t(2;11) and CCND1 Overexpression.
trials.summary: A rare multiple myeloma genetic mutation was successfully treated with venetoclax, achieving sustained remission for over three years.

trials.title: Rationale and Trial Design of DAWNA-FES Trial: Single-Arm Phase II Study of Endocrine Therapy With Dalpiciclib After Progression on CDK4/6 Inhibition Based on [18F]FES PET/CT in Patients With HR+/HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers are testing a new CDK4/6 inhibitor (dalpiciclib) combined with hormone therapy for HR+/HER2- breast cancer that resisted prior CDK4/6 drugs, guided by estrogen receptor imaging.

trials.title: From T cells to NK cells and macrophages: progress and challenges in CAR-based therapies and the involved gene delivery systems.
trials.summary: Researchers are expanding CAR cell therapies beyond T cells to NK cells and macrophages, using safer non-viral delivery methods to treat more cancer types.

trials.title: Hospital 3D-printed cyclophosphamide printlets for paediatric patients.
trials.summary: Hospitals can 3D-print customized cyclophosphamide tablets for children with cancer, offering flexible dosing and stable storage.

trials.title: Spinal epidermoid cyst: illustrative case.
trials.summary: Spinal epidermoid cysts are rare benign tumors best treated by surgical removal, though incomplete resection risks recurrence.

trials.title: A Microchip-Based Gauge for Visual Prediction of Immunotherapy via Distance Readout of Microvesicles.
trials.summary: A microchip test detects salivary particles to rapidly predict which oral cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans in a resource-limited setting: Diagnostic delays and surgical management in a 10-patient institutional series.
trials.summary: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans cases in low-income settings benefit from wide surgical removal and reconstruction, with radiotherapy for high-risk patients.

trials.title: Genetics and MRD for therapy allocation in adults with Philadelphia chromosome-negative acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
trials.summary: Combining genetic testing with measurable residual disease levels helps doctors choose the best treatment—stem cell transplant or chemotherapy—for adults with Philadelphia chromosome-negative acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
